svg.title: The byte layout of samples/seven.wav
svg.desc: Three rows of byte fields. Row one, the 12-byte RIFF header: the letters RIFF, the file size minus 8 (32036), the letters WAVE. Row two, the fmt chunk: its name, its size 16, format tag 1 for PCM, 1 channel, sample rate 16000, byte rate 32000, block align 2, 16 bits per sample. Row three, the data chunk: its name, its size 32000, then the samples, two bytes each, starting -1, -1, -1, -2.
svg.text: all integers little-endian: lowest byte first
Every chunk has the same shape:
minus these 8 bytes, plus the samples.
